source_title: Celebrating Two Decades Of Keeping Commerce Human

snippets.snippet_text: "The creativity of our 5.6 million sellers provides unending inspiration and fuels our mission to Keep Commerce Human, despite an industry-wide move toward commoditization and soulless goods."

intake_notes: Etsy official news post (June 25, 2025). Etsy self-reported seller count: 5.6 million sellers.
No active/inactive distinction made in the snippet; unclear if this refers to active or total registered sellers.
possible_subjects: Etsy: 5.6 million sellers as of June 2025 (self-reported)
